note: Per-page OCR throughput. total_s is encode + prefill + decode for ONE page, which is the shape of the 32.4 s/page median in; prefill alone is ttft_s - encode_s. tokens=2048 because a surya page is 2100-3200 output tokens, so a 32-token sample would not be a page. The encode runs once up front (metadata encode_s) and once inside every repetition, so this case is reps+2 = 5 CPU-ViT passes.

label: surya2-peshwa21-t2048
note: Halving the merged-token budget quarters the ViT's dense attention term, which is 78% of its 12.7 TFLOP at the full budget. reps=1 because one CPU-ViT pass at this budget is minutes; determinism is still gated, because serving_bench compares every run against the unprinted warmup.
